softwareInnerHero.title: Revolutionize Your Quantity Takeoff Process
paragraphs: PlainSwift is an innovative quantity takeoff software designed to streamline the estimation process for construction professionals. With its powerful measurement tools and intuitive interface, PlainSwift makes quantifying materials from digital plans faster and more accurate than ever before.

Our software supports multiple file formats including PDF, DWG, and BIM models, allowing you to perform precise takeoffs directly on digital blueprints. The automated calculations and customizable reporting features save valuable time while ensuring accuracy in your estimates.
At Aptus Infotech, we provide PlainSwift with comprehensive training and support to help construction firms in Oman optimize their estimating workflows and improve project profitability.

cardSections.subheading: Discover the capabilities that make PlainSwift the ultimate takeoff solution

items.title: Precision Measurement Tools
items.body: Perform accurate linear, area, and volume measurements with advanced digital tools.

items.title: Multi-Format Support
items.body: Import and work with various file formats including PDF, DWG, DXF, BIM models, and raster images.

items.title: Advanced Layer Management
items.body: Organize your takeoffs with customizable layers and color coding.

items.title: Assembly Libraries
items.body: Create and save reusable assemblies for common construction components. Quickly apply complex measurements with a single click.

items.title: Customizable Reporting
items.body: Generate professional reports with customizable templates. Export data to Excel, PDF, or integrate with estimating software for seamless workflows.

items.title: Cloud Collaboration
items.body: Share projects with team members, track changes, and collaborate in real-time. Maintain version control and audit trails for all takeoff activities.
